returned_textual_content: # Data Domain homepage When you click on a Data Domain tile on the main `Domains` landing page, you are taken to the homepage of an individual domain, where you can access all domain functionality. 1. Use the Domain Spine to move between the main parts of the domain, including Home, AI Assistant, Reference Hub, Lineage Models, saved Data Maps, and other core areas. 2. Use breadcrumbs to move back through the current domain path. 3. Click the three-dots icon to open the domain and Data Map [Settings](/data-domains/build-data-domains/edit-data-domains). 4. Click to open the domain [Data Map](/data-domains/data-maps). 5. Enter search terms or a query in the search bar and press `Enter` to view the results. 6. Click to open the [The Query Helper](/data-domains/explore-data-domains/query-data-domains#the-query-helper) with examples of valid predicate syntax that you can fill in with your own terms. 7. Click to open the [Data Assets](/models/understand-solidatus-models/data-assets-101) section, which lists all Data Assets in the domain. 8. View, open, create, edit, and delete [Analytics reports](/data-domains/analytics-reports) from the domain home experience. 9. View, open, and create [Data Map views](/data-domains/explore-data-domains/save-and-share-data-map-views). 10. Open the Lineage Models area to browse all connected lineage models in the domain. 11. Open the Reference Hub directly from the Domain Spine to browse published reference content in the same domain context. {% hint style="success" %} The options visible here reflect what an Owner of a Data Domain would see on the homepage. {% endhint %} If you are a Member of the domain with read-only access, you will not see the three-dots to access domain `Settings`. To help find the Analytics Reports or Data Map views you need, you can open an expanded list. Click the arrow at the top-right corner of the Analytics reports or Data Map views tiles. {% hint style="success" %} For more information about how to explore a Data Map, and about the integration of Data Maps in Data Domains, visit the [Data Maps](/data-domains/data-maps) section. {% endhint %} ## Analytics Reports 1. Click the name of an Analytics Report to open it. 2. Click the three-dots menu to edit or delete an Analytics Report. Be careful when deleting. Deleted reports cannot be recovered. ## Data Map Views 1. Search for Data Map views by name. 2. Click the name of a view to open it. 3. Click the three-dots menu to delete a Data Map view. Be careful when deleting. Deleted views cannot be recovered. {% hint style="success" %} Only Owners of a Data Domain are able to delete Data Map views and Analytics Reports. The three-dots menu will not appear in the expanded dialog if you are not an Owner of the domain. {% endhint %}
